title: The Star Card in the Barn
lines: Dan and Dad park the car at the farm.
Dad and Dan step into the dark barn.
Dan digs in a box of rags and jars.
Then Dan spots a jar on the top shelf.
Dan can not see what is in it.
He runs to the yard with the jar.
In the sun, he tips the jar up.
A card slips into his hand.
It has a big gold star on it.
Dad grins. That card was Dad's as a kid.
Dad lets Dan hold the star card.

questions.ask: What slipped into Dan's hand when he tipped the jar up?
questions.listenFor: A card with a big gold star on it. Point back to the line if they guess.

questions.ask: Why did Dan run to the yard with the jar?
questions.listenFor: He could not see what was in it in the barn. Out in the sun he could. The answer sits in the two lines above.

questions.ask: How do you think Dad felt about the card? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The grin, or the card being his as a kid, both work.
